clusters.headline: Vice President Gibran Addresses Resignation Intent Amid Legal Case
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran reported his intention to resign to President Prabowo, following ongoing discussions regarding his educational credentials.
President Prabowo reportedly advised the Vice President to pursue legal action regarding the diploma ruling instead of stepping down.

clusters.headline: Hidayat Nur Wahid Resigns As Deputy Speaker Of The Indonesian MPR
aiSummaryBullets: Hidayat Nur Wahid officially resigned from his position as Deputy Speaker of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on November 10, 2026.
The Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) has appointed Mohamad Sohibul Iman to serve as the successor for the vacant deputy leadership role.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Discharge Senior Officer Over Illegal Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police dismissed Irjen Ahrie Sonta after an ethics committee found him guilty of unauthorized wiretapping.
The investigation concluded that the former official committed professional misconduct regarding the surveillance of the President.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Confers National Hero Titles On 19 Figures
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto bestowed the National Hero title upon 19 figures recognized for their historical contributions.
The list includes RM Margono Djojohadikusumo, the president's grandfather and a prominent economic figure, alongside others like Hoegeng and Maraden Panggabean.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Disagree On Gibran Diploma Verification Plan
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran expressed an intent to verify his high school diploma's authenticity through the Administrative Court (PTUN).
Legal experts and officials argue that previous rulings by the Constitutional Court and Supreme Court on the matter are already final.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Advance Opinion Rights Regarding Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have formally signed a proposal to initiate an opinion rights procedure concerning the Vice President.
Parliamentary leadership has acknowledged the petition while confirming they respect parallel legal proceedings currently underway at the Administrative Court.

clusters.headline: Three Prominent PSI Leaders Resign To Focus On Government Roles
aiSummaryBullets: High-ranking members Giring Ganesha, Raja Juli Antoni, and Isyana Bagoes Oka have formally stepped down from the Indonesian Solidarity Party.
The officials cited the need to dedicate their full attention to their respective responsibilities within the government.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Announces Winners Of The Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta provincial government recognized local environmental contributors through the Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026 program.
Winners of the initiative will serve as ambassadors for the provincial government to promote waste management practices.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Ruling On Vice President Gibran Diploma Finalized
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ruled that there is no evidence verifying Gibran Rakabuming Raka possesses a high school-equivalent diploma from abroad.
The court ordered the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education to revoke the certificate of equivalency previously issued to the Vice President.

clusters.headline: Prosecutors Oppose Silmy Karim Legal Challenge In Extortion Case
aiSummaryBullets: Prosecution lawyers from the KPK have requested the court to dismiss a legal challenge filed by Silmy Karim.
The legal counsel for the accused argues that the absence of a sting operation makes the extortion charges difficult to substantiate.
